subuh.desc: Solat Sunat Qabliyah Subuh amat dituntut.
subuh.benefit: 'Dua rakaat Fajar lebih baik dari dunia dan seisinya' (HR. Muslim).

zuhur.desc: Bermula bila matahari tergelincir dari puncak langit.
zuhur.benefit: Allah haramkan api neraka bagi yang memelihara 4 rakaat sebelum dan selepas Zuhur.

asar.benefit: Siapa menunaikan solat Subuh dan Asar dijanjikan syurga (HR. Bukhari & Muslim).

maghrib.benefit: Solat Sunat Ba'diyyah Maghrib mendatangkan keberkatan dan cahaya malam.

isya.desc: Bermula selepas hilangnya mega merah di ufuk.
isya.benefit: Disunatkan menutup ibadah malam dengan Solat Sunat Witir.

syuruk.desc: Detik matahari terbit di ufuk timur. Dilarang solat pada waktu ini.
syuruk.benefit: Dianjurkan berzikir hingga matahari naik untuk solat Sunat Duha.

duha.desc: Waktu pagi setelah matahari meninggi segalah hingga sebelum Zuhur.
duha.benefit: Mencukupi sedekah bagi seluruh 360 sendi tubuh badan.

imsak.desc: Waktu berjaga-jaga (~10 minit sebelum Subuh) untuk tamat sahur.
imsak.benefit: Memastikan ibadah puasa dimulakan dengan penuh yakin dan tertib.

subuh.desc: Fajr marks the true dawn light on the horizon.
subuh.benefit: 'Two rak'ahs before Fajr are better than the entire world' (Sahih Muslim).

zuhur.desc: Starts after the sun passes its highest point.
zuhur.benefit: Maintaining Sunnah prayers around Zuhr shields against the Hellfire.

asar.desc: The middle prayer during afternoon hours.
asar.benefit: Whoever guards Fajr and Asr enters Paradise without delay.

maghrib.desc: Begins immediately upon sunset until dusk fades.
maghrib.benefit: Performing Sunnah rak'ahs after Maghrib brings divine peace into the home.

isya.desc: Commences once the twilight glow completely fades.
isya.benefit: The Prophet SAW encouraged concluding night prayers with Witr.

syuruk.desc: The exact sunrise interval. Voluntary prayers are prohibited.
syuruk.benefit: Engage in morning remembrance until Dhuha time begins.

duha.desc: From mid-morning until shortly before Zuhr.
duha.benefit: Suffices as daily charity for every joint in your body.

imsak.desc: Precautionary interval (~10 mins before Fajr) to conclude Sahur.
imsak.benefit: Allows fasting to begin with accuracy and reassurance.
